title: Senior Distributed Systems Engineer
description: Talvora is seeking a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, scalability, and resilience of our core event streaming and durable outbox processing pipelines. In this role, you will design fault-tolerant messaging topologies, optimize monotonic lease fencing protocols, and ensure sub-second p95 latencies across high-throughput tenant operations.

draft_requirements.source_requirement_text: Minimum 5 years (60 months) of hands-on software engineering experience designing high-concurrency backend services.
draft_requirements.relevance_rationale: Ensures the engineer can independently design distributed transaction systems and resolve complex race conditions.

draft_requirements.source_requirement_text: Demonstrated expertise in Python 3.12+, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy async query execution.
draft_requirements.relevance_rationale: Core application runtime is built on Python and modern asynchronous ASGI architecture.

draft_requirements.source_requirement_text: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or closely related technical discipline, or equivalent practical industry experience.
draft_requirements.relevance_rationale: Foundational grounding in data structures, concurrency primitives, and operating systems.

draft_requirements.source_requirement_text: Must possess active US Secret (or higher) security clearance or demonstrate eligibility for immediate federal sponsorship.
draft_requirements.relevance_rationale: Government enterprise customer workloads operate under strict compliance and citizenship clearance requirements.

configuration.human_verification_prompt: Recruiter must verify candidate security clearance status via JPAS/DISS lookup or validated client documentation prior to interview scheduling.
configuration.guidelines: Do not request foreign passport details or national origin documents. Verification is strictly restricted to cleared status verification with sponsoring facility security officer (FSO).

draft_requirements.source_requirement_text: Experience with Rust or Go for low-level systems programming and high-performance network services.
draft_requirements.relevance_rationale: Future compute-bound document parsing and OCR workers may be implemented in compiled systems languages.

draft_requirements.source_requirement_text: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) or equivalent cloud infrastructure credential.
draft_requirements.relevance_rationale: Talvora is deployed on single-region AWS managed services (RDS PostgreSQL, ECS, SQS, S3).
